name: set_midi_mode_user
when_to_send: Startup + Panic + after USB reconnect. Push boots in Live mode; persistence across power cycle is undocumented.

name: set_midi_mode_live
when_to_send: Shutdown / release Push back to Ableton Live.

name: set_midi_mode_dual
when_to_send: Only if Ableton Live must run at the same time.

name: set_led_brightness
when_to_send: Hardware caps to 8 on USB power only.

name: set_display_brightness
when_to_send: 0-255 split as 7-bit LSB + 1-bit MSB. Send 0 to keep the display dark.

name: set_palette_entry
when_to_send: Each 8-bit value split as 7-bit LSB then 1-bit MSB. 11 bytes of payload, one message per index.

name: reapply_palette
when_to_send: Send once after writing all palette entries.

name: set_touchstrip_config
when_to_send: bit0 LED owner, bit1 sysex vs values, bit2 modwheel vs pitchbend, bit3 point vs bar, bit4 centre vs bottom, bit5 autoreturn, bit6 autoreturn target. Default 0x68.

name: device_inquiry
when_to_send: Standard MIDI, NOT the Ableton header. Reply confirms Push presence, firmware and serial.
